title: Evaluating Spatial Underperformance: A Spatial Computable General Equilibrium Model Applied to Ho Chi Minh City
title_primary: Evaluating Spatial Underperformance: A Spatial Computable General Equilibrium Model Applied to Ho Chi Minh City
authors: Bird, Julia, Venables, Anthony, Dehe, Henry, Rubinyi, Steven Louis, Wibisana, Putu Sanjiwacika 等
source: World Bank Policy Research Working Papers
official: 官方在线 2026-09-09 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Thu Duc, a rapidly urbanizing area of Ho Chi Minh City, is well located and heavily invested in policy ambition, yet its output and density remain far below what its position in the metropolitan economy would support. Much of it is also flood exposed. This paper asks how much of that shortfall flood risk explains, and what coordinated investment could recover. A Spatial Computable General Equilibrium model of the Greater Ho Chi Minh City Metropolitan Area, covering 116 cells across Ho Chi Minh City and neighboring provinces, evaluates interventions to 2040. The model endogenizes firm location, household residence and commuting, land use intensity, and agglomeration externalities, recovering cell-level productivity and amenity parameters by structural calibration against observed employment and residential distributions. Its methodological contribution is to integrate spatially explicit flood exposure as a determinant of those fundamentals, so flood risk is evaluated within the same general equilibrium framework as transport and land use, and local gains can be separated into net new metropolitan output and activity reallocated from elsewhere. Thu Duc's calibrated productivity is roughly one-third of the metropolitan average, implying that frontier output is more than five times the business-as-usual level. Flood mitigation raises sectoral total factor productivity by 12 to 21 percent and residential amenity by 10 to 13 percent, and it broadens the sectoral employment base more than the other interventions examined. A cumulative package of innovation zones, flood mitigation, and transport reaches about 31 percent of that frontier, raising output roughly two-thirds above business as usual, of which some 56 percent is net new output for the metropolis.

title: Competing sellers in security-bid auctions under risk-averse bidders
title_zh: 风险厌恶投标人下证券竞价拍卖中的竞争性卖方
title_primary: 风险厌恶投标人下证券竞价拍卖中的竞争性卖方
title_secondary: Competing sellers in security-bid auctions under risk-averse bidders
authors: Diego Carrasco, Allan Hernández-Chanto
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-09-07 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study second-price security-bid auctions in which two risk-neutral sellers compete for risk-averse bidders. Each seller selects a family of securities—such as equity, debt, or call options—before bidders choose which auction to enter. Steeper families of securities extract more surplus from bidders ex post but may deter entry; they also provide greater insurance, prompting more aggressive bidding. When bidders have homogeneous risk aversion, no asymmetric pure-strategy equilibria exist. In contrast, when risk aversion is heterogeneous, an asymmetric equilibrium emerges: one seller chooses a steeper family to attract more risk-averse bidders, while the other chooses a flatter family to appeal to less risk-averse ones. These results show how variation in bidder preferences can lead to market segmentation and shape sellers’ strategic choices over security design in auctions.

title: A hangover like any other: the cost of ruling for populist parties
title_zh: 宿醉如常：民粹主义政党的执政代价
title_primary: 宿醉如常：民粹主义政党的执政代价
title_secondary: A hangover like any other: the cost of ruling for populist parties
authors: Andreas Bergh, Anders Kärnä
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-25 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Populist parties have grown rapidly in popularity in many European countries and have increasingly become common in government coalitions. Because these parties often make expansive promises and derive much of their appeal from their outsider status, entering government may become an electoral liability by the next election. Analyzing populist and mainstream parties in 32 European countries from 1980 to 2023, we estimate the average electoral effect of government participation. We find a post-power penalty of about 4.5–5 percentage points on average. This penalty is remarkably similar for populist and mainstream parties, suggesting that populist parties do not suffer an additional electoral cost from governing. Moreover, the size of the post-power penalty does not vary systematically with growth, inequality, social spending, globalization, or unemployment during the governing term. These findings suggest that bringing populist parties into government does not, by itself, impose a distinctive electoral cost on them relative to other incumbent parties.
abstract_zh: 民粹主义政党在许多欧洲国家的支持率迅速上升，并日益成为政府联盟中的常见成员。由于这些政党往往做出宏大的承诺，并主要依靠其局外人身份吸引选民，进入政府可能会在下次选举中成为其选举上的不利因素。通过分析1980年至2023年间32个欧洲国家的民粹主义政党与主流政党，我们估计了政府参与的平均选举效应。研究发现，执政后平均存在约4.5至5个百分点的惩罚效应。这一惩罚对民粹主义政党与主流政党而言惊人地相似，表明民粹主义政党并未因执政而承担额外的选举成本。此外，执政期间的增长、不平等、社会支出、全球化或失业率并未系统性地改变执政后惩罚的大小。这些发现表明，将民粹主义政党纳入政府本身，并不会相对于其他执政党对其施加独特的选举成本。

title: Understanding land use philosophy through ontology and epistemology
title_zh: 从本体论与认识论视角理解土地利用哲学
title_primary: 从本体论与认识论视角理解土地利用哲学
title_secondary: Understanding land use philosophy through ontology and epistemology
authors: Yousef Sakieh, Teea Kortetmäki
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-22 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Land use planning, as a scientific discipline, is a nexus among philosophy of science, planning theories and methodological frameworks. It is built primarily upon two distinct schools of thought, landscape ecology and land ecology, each supported by different ontological roots and epistemic commitments. The methodologies in this domain have been extensively developed and refined at a technical level; however, the underlying philosophies and ethical implications remain largely implicit. Consequently, spatial planning practices can potentially be stuck in a path-dependent cycle, where ethical blind spots and methodological numbness can arise. The current study analyzes how such foundations are embedded within the theories and methodologies of influential schools of thought in land use planning, a situation which currently constitutes a research gap. We address this gap by examining the epistemological and ethical underpinnings, and their methodological and planning implications, of both schools of thought. More specifically, our examination compares the way these planning approaches conceptualize, componentize and synthesize the land for planning and how they treat integration of socioeconomic and ecological data and delineate land units. Our analysis also shows how they rely on inductive and deductive reasoning, or causal and correlational analysis and how methodological choices can affect the level of holism/reductionism and non-anthropocentrism/anthropocentrism in the methodologies. This philosophical and analytical study contributes to advancing discussion and methodological innovations in land use science.
abstract_zh: 土地利用规划作为一门科学学科，是科学哲学、规划理论与方法论框架的交汇点。它主要建立在两种不同的思想流派之上，即景观生态学与土地生态学，各自依托不同的本体论根源和认识论承诺。该领域的方法论在技术层面已得到广泛发展与完善；然而，其背后的哲学基础与伦理意涵在很大程度上仍处于隐含状态。因此，空间规划实践可能陷入路径依赖的循环之中，从而产生伦理盲区与方法论麻木。本研究分析了这些基础如何嵌入土地利用规划中有影响力的思想流派的理论与方法之中，而这一现状目前构成了研究空白。我们通过考察这两种思想流派的认识论与伦理基础及其方法论和规划意涵来填补这一空白。更具体而言，我们的比较分析审视了这些规划方法在概念化、要素化及综合化土地以供规划之用的方式，以及它们如何处理社会经济与生态数据的整合并划定土地单元。我们的分析还揭示了它们如何依赖归纳与演绎推理，或因果与相关分析，以及方法论选择如何影响方法论中的整体主义/还原主义和非人类中心主义/人类中心主义水平。这项哲学与分析性研究有助于推动土地利用科学领域的讨论深化与方法论创新。

title: How did the Canada Child Benefit affect household bargaining?
title_zh: 加拿大儿童福利如何影响家庭议价？
title_primary: 加拿大儿童福利如何影响家庭议价？
title_secondary: How did the Canada Child Benefit affect household bargaining?
authors: Shirleen Manzur, Krishna Pendakur
official: 官方在线 2026-08-17 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Child benefits in Canada are sizable, targeted to children and paid to custodial mothers, and so might be expected to affect household resource allocations and spousal bargaining. The introduction of the Canada Child Benefit in July 2016 more than doubled the amount of child benefits received by households with children. We estimate the effect of this change on the preferences and resource shares of men and women within dual‐parent households. Resource shares, defined as the fraction of household expenditure consumed by women versus men, are important parameters of collective household models. Using a difference‐in‐differences strategy within a structural collective household model, we find little evidence that preferences of either men or women changed in response to the increase in child benefits. However, we do find evidence that the policy increased female resource shares, but only among homeowner (and not renter) households. We discuss this heterogeneity in the treatment effect between owners and renters and suggest potential underlying mechanisms.
abstract_zh: 加拿大的儿童福利金数额可观，专门针对儿童发放，并支付给监护母亲，因此可能预期会影响家庭资源配置和配偶间的议价能力。2016年7月推出的加拿大儿童福利金使有子女家庭获得的儿童福利金额增加了一倍以上。我们估计了这一变化对双亲家庭中男性和女性偏好及资源份额的影响。资源份额，即女性相对于男性所消费的家庭支出比例，是集体家庭模型中的重要参数。利用结构集体家庭模型中的双重差分策略，我们发现几乎没有证据表明男性或女性的偏好因儿童福利金的增加而发生变化。然而，我们确实发现该政策提高了女性的资源份额，但仅限于有房家庭（而非租房家庭）。我们讨论了房主与租户之间处理效应的这种异质性，并提出了潜在的潜在机制。

title: Teen Suicide and the Outcomes of Surviving Peers
title_zh: 青少年自杀与幸存同伴的结果
title_primary: 青少年自杀与幸存同伴的结果
title_secondary: Teen Suicide and the Outcomes of Surviving Peers
authors: Emily Cuddy, Janet Currie, Elisa Jácome, Lucy Manly
official: 官方在线 2026-08-17 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: By age 17, a quarter of U.S. students have experienced a peer suicide. Using linked administrative data from South Carolina and a matched difference-in-differences design, we find that exposure to a peer's self-harm death increases the probability of a self-harm diagnosis by nearly 50% and both the incidence and frequency of mental health visits. Effects on care use and criminal behavior are concentrated among white boys, and responses diverge by prior mental health history: students without a prior diagnosis increase felony offending rather than care-seeking. Deaths from assault and transportation accidents produce no comparable rise in self-harm, consistent with contagion.
abstract_zh: 到17岁时，美国已有四分之一的学生经历过同伴自杀。利用南卡罗来纳州的关联行政数据及匹配的双重差分设计，我们发现，接触同伴自伤死亡事件会使自伤诊断的概率增加近50%，并提高心理健康就诊的发生率与频率。对医疗服务使用及犯罪行为的影响主要集中在白人男孩中，且反应因先前心理健康史而异：无先前诊断的学生更倾向于增加重罪犯罪而非寻求医疗服务。因袭击和交通事故导致的死亡并未引发类似的自伤增加，这与传染效应一致。

title: From global benchmarking to local policy readiness: Assessing governance capacity for multipurpose cadastre implementation
title_zh: 从全球对标到地方政策准备：多用途地籍实施的治理能力评估
title_primary: 从全球对标到地方政策准备：多用途地籍实施的治理能力评估
title_secondary: From global benchmarking to local policy readiness: Assessing governance capacity for multipurpose cadastre implementation
authors: Riyanatou Medessi, Tchaa Boukpessi, El-Ayachi Moha
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-12 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Multipurpose cadastre implementation is increasingly promoted as a key instrument for improving land administration, urban planning, taxation, service delivery, and land governance. However, local capacity to operationalise such systems remains uneven, particularly in peri-urban contexts where land pressure, institutional fragmentation, and weak cadastral documentation coexist. This study develops and tests a governance-readiness framework for assessing local capacity to support multipurpose cadastre implementation. Drawing on a purposive benchmarking sample of sixteen localities selected from a preliminary longlist of candidate cases across Africa, Europe, Asia, and North America, the study combines normalised governance indicators with partial least squares structural equation modelling (PLS-SEM). Governance readiness is modelled as a second-order formative construct, while Performance of Land Governance (PLG) is specified as a reflective outcome construct. The results show a strong positive relationship between governance readiness and PLG, with a standardised path coefficient of β = 0.849 and an explained variance of R² = 0.721. Robustness checks using Spearman rank correlation and ordinary least squares regression confirm the stability of this relationship, with ρ = 0.954 and OLS R² = 0.965. Agoè-Nyivé 2, located in the rapidly urbanising Greater Lomé metropolitan area in Togo, records particularly low readiness and PLG scores, highlighting the gap between cadastral needs and local governance capacity. The findings suggest that multipurpose cadastre implementation should be approached as a policy-readiness process requiring transparency, accountability, institutional coordination, technical capacity, and reliable land information systems.
abstract_zh: 多用途地籍的实施日益被推崇为改善土地管理、城市规划、税收、服务提供及土地治理的关键工具。然而，地方在运作此类系统方面的能力仍不均衡，尤其是在土地压力、制度碎片化及地籍文件薄弱并存的城郊地区。本研究开发并测试了一个治理就绪度框架，用以评估地方支持多用途地籍实施的能力。研究选取了来自非洲、欧洲、亚洲和北美洲的初步候选案例长名单中的十六个地方作为目的性基准样本，结合标准化治理指标与偏最小二乘结构方程模型（PLS-SEM）进行分析。治理就绪度被建模为二阶形成性构念，而土地治理绩效（PLG）则被设定为反映性结果构念。结果显示，治理就绪度与PLG之间存在强正相关关系，标准化路径系数为β = 0.849，解释方差为R² = 0.721。采用斯皮尔曼秩相关和普通最小二乘回归进行的稳健性检验确认了该关系的稳定性，ρ = 0.954，OLS R² = 0.965。位于多哥大洛美都市区快速城市化地区的Agoè-Nyivé 2，其就绪度和PLG得分均特别低，凸显了地籍需求与地方治理能力之间的差距。研究结果表明，多用途地籍的实施应被视为一个政策就绪过程，需要透明度、问责制、机构协调、技术能力及可靠的土地信息系统。

title: Agricultural extension services for farm resilience in Russian–Ukrainian Conflict
title_zh: 俄乌冲突背景下农业推广服务对农场韧性的作用
title_primary: 俄乌冲突背景下农业推广服务对农场韧性的作用
title_secondary: Agricultural extension services for farm resilience in Russian–Ukrainian Conflict
authors: Bekhzod Egamberdiev, Mukhayyo Djuraeva, Ihtiyor Bobojonov, Lena Kuhn, Thomas Glauben
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-10 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We analyse how agricultural extension services affect farm resilience using the Post-Russian Invasion Survey of Smallholder Farmers in Ukraine for 2022–3. Farm household resilience is measured using the Resilience Capacity Index (RCI), constructed from Adaptive Capacity (AC), Assets (AST), Social Safety Nets (SSN), and Sensitivity (S). To address the heterogeneity problem, Latent Profile Analysis (LPA) defines homogenous resilience profiles. The manuscript also examines a causal relationship by incorporating treatment effects into latent analysis. The results reveal that extension service receivers experience higher levels of AST and SSN. The extension service has a positive effect on RCI levels.
abstract_zh: 我们利用2022-2023年乌克兰小农户战后入侵调查数据，分析农业推广服务如何影响农场韧性。农场家庭韧性通过韧性能力指数（RCI）衡量，该指数由适应能力（AC）、资产（AST）、社会安全网（SSN）和敏感性（S）构成。为应对异质性问题，采用潜在剖面分析（LPA）定义同质韧性剖面。本文还通过将处理效应纳入潜在分析，考察因果关系。结果显示，接受推广服务的农户在AST和SSN方面水平更高。推广服务对RCI水平具有正向影响。

title: The effect of disaster relief on climate adaptation: Evidence from floods in Pakistan
title_zh: 灾害救济对气候适应的影响：来自巴基斯坦洪水的证据
title_primary: 灾害救济对气候适应的影响：来自巴基斯坦洪水的证据
title_secondary: The effect of disaster relief on climate adaptation: Evidence from floods in Pakistan
authors: Muhammad Bin Khalid, Martin Mattsson
official: 官方在线 2026-08-06 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Extreme weather events are expected to increase with climate change. Government relief programs are designed to ameliorate the negative consequences, but moral hazard models suggest they also reduce adaptation, such as migrating from disaster-prone areas. Using difference-in-differences, we study the long-term effects of cash relief on migration after the 2010 Pakistan floods. Combining survey and population data, we show that cash transfers have two countervailing effects. As expected, they reduce migration through a moral hazard effect and by facilitating in-situ adaptation. However, they also increase migration by providing liquidity. In practice, these effects cancel each other out in flooded areas.
abstract_zh: 随着气候变化，极端天气事件预计将增多。政府救济项目旨在缓解其负面影响，但道德风险模型表明，这些项目也可能减少适应行为，例如从灾害频发地区迁移。利用双重差分法，我们研究了2010年巴基斯坦洪水后现金救济对迁移的长期影响。结合调查与人口数据，我们发现现金转移具有两种相互抵消的效应。正如预期，它们通过道德风险效应及促进就地适应减少了迁移。然而，它们也通过提供流动性增加了迁移。在实践中，这些效应在受灾地区相互抵消。

title: The political returns to women’s inheritance rights in India
title_zh: 印度女性继承权的政治回报
title_primary: 印度女性继承权的政治回报
title_secondary: The political returns to women’s inheritance rights in India
authors: Bharti Nandwani, Punarjit Roychowdhury
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: 来源期次 2026-08-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper examines whether granting property inheritance rights to women improves their participation in politics as election candidates in India. Leveraging state-level changes in inheritance laws and large-scale election data, we find that improved property rights increase female candidacy and their chances of winning elections. The reforms particularly encourage regional parties to nominate more women, with a notable rise in new female candidates. We show that these results are not confounded by pre-existing trends and are robust to treatment effect heterogeneity. We provide suggestive evidence that the rise in political participation stems from gains in women’s financial autonomy and shifts in restrictive gender norms due to the reforms. Our findings underscore the potential for legal and institutional reforms that expand women’s economic agency to generate meaningful political empowerment and reduce gender gaps in political representation.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了赋予女性财产继承权是否能够提升她们作为选举候选人的政治参与度。利用各邦继承法的变动及大规模选举数据，我们发现财产权的改善增加了女性候选人的数量及其当选的概率。改革尤其鼓励地区政党提名更多女性，新女性候选人显著增多。我们证明这些结果不受既有趋势的干扰，并对处理效应异质性具有稳健性。我们提供的初步证据表明，政治参与度的提升源于改革带来的女性财务自主权增强及限制性性别规范的转变。我们的研究结果强调了扩大女性经济自主权的法律与制度改革的潜力，能够产生实质性的政治赋权效果，并缩小政治代表中的性别差距。

title: Regression adjustment in completely randomized experiments with many covariates
title_zh: 完全随机实验中多协变量的回归调整
title_primary: 完全随机实验中多协变量的回归调整
title_secondary: Regression adjustment in completely randomized experiments with many covariates
authors: Harold D. Chiang, Yukitoshi Matsushita, Taisuke Otsu
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-29 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper investigates estimation and inference for average treatment effects in completely randomized experiments when researchers observe potentially many covariates. Within Neyman's (1923) design-based framework, allowing the number of covariates to grow more slowly than the sample size, we demonstrate that a cross-fitted regression adjustment estimator--adapted from Aronow and Middleton (2013)--exhibits more favorable asymptotic properties than existing alternatives, such as Lin's (2013) regression adjustment estimator and the bias-corrected estimator of Lei and Ding (2021). For inference, we derive the first- and second-order terms in the stochastic expansions of regression-adjusted estimators, analyze the higher-order behavior of existing inference procedures, and introduce a modified version of the HC3 standard error. The proposed methods extend naturally to stratified experiments with large strata. Simulation studies show that the cross-fitted estimator, in combination with the modified HC3, provides accurate point estimates and reliable size control across a wide range of data-generating processes.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了在完全随机化实验中，当研究者观察到可能众多协变量时，平均处理效应的估计与推断问题。在Neyman（1923）的设计框架内，允许协变量数量以慢于样本量的速度增长，我们证明了一种交叉拟合回归调整估计量——改编自Aronow和Middleton（2013）——相较于现有替代方法，如Lin（2013）的回归调整估计量和Lei与Ding（2021）的偏差校正估计量，展现出更优的渐近性质。在推断方面，我们推导了回归调整估计量随机展开中的一阶和二阶项，分析了现有推断程序的高阶行为，并引入了修正版HC3标准误。所提方法自然扩展至具有大层数的分层实验。模拟研究表明，交叉拟合估计量结合修正HC3，在广泛的数据生成过程中提供了精确的点估计和可靠的规模控制。

title: Regulating investments when both costs and need are private
title_zh: 当成本和需求均为私人信息时的投资监管
title_primary: 当成本和需求均为私人信息时的投资监管
title_secondary: Regulating investments when both costs and need are private
authors: Daniel F. Garrett, Е А Панова
official: 官方在线 2026-07-22 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Large-scale infrastructure investments are often carried out in settings where their eventual usefulness or importance is difficult to predict. This paper studies optimal incentives for investment when the agent undertaking the investment has superior information on two dimensions: the cost of investment and the likelihood it is useful or beneficial to the principal. Usefulness eventually becomes public, but punishments are limited as the regulator aims at ensuring the agent earns non-negative profits in each period. We characterize the optimal incentive scheme and show it involves either: (i) investments by the agent even though he knows they are useless and rents to only cost-efficient types, or (ii) rents to all types. The possibility that rent is left to all types contrasts with the usual prediction in static (and also dynamic) mechanism design and arises even though the agent’s preferences are stable over time.
abstract_zh: 大规模基础设施投资往往在其实用性或重要性难以预测的环境中进行。本文研究了当承担投资的代理人在两个维度上拥有信息优势时的最优激励问题：投资成本以及投资对委托人而言有用或有益的可能性。实用性最终会公开，但由于监管者旨在确保代理人每期获得非负利润，惩罚措施受到限制。我们刻画了最优激励方案，并表明其涉及以下两种情况之一：（i）代理人即使知道投资无用仍进行投资，且仅向成本效率高的类型支付租金；或（ii）向所有类型支付租金。向所有类型留下租金的可能性与静态（以及动态）机制设计中的通常预测形成对比，并且即使在代理人偏好随时间保持稳定的情况下也会出现。

title: There Goes the Neighborhood? The Local Impacts of State Policies that Override Municipal Zoning
title_zh: 邻里何去何从？州政策超越市镇区划的地方影响

authors: Blanco, Hector, Sportiche, Noémie
official: 来源期次 American Economic Journal: Applied Economics · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: Zoning regulations drive rising regional housing costs and residential segregation in the United States. In response, governments are passing laws to override local regulations that limit housing density, despite entrenched opposition from incumbent residents. We study how residents living near housing permitted under one such law, Massachusetts’ Chapter 40B, are affected by and respond to this new, denser housing. Exploiting hyperlocal variation in proximity to 40B developments, we find that the average development does not affect these residents’ property values (95% CI: [–0.4%, 2.4%]). For larger developments that do decrease values, outmigration and political responses are small or non-existent.
abstract_zh: 美国的分区法规推高了地区住房成本并加剧了居住隔离。为此，各州政府正通过立法来推翻限制住房密度的地方法规，尽管面临现有居民的强烈反对。我们研究了在马萨诸塞州《第40B章》这类法律许可下，居住在新建高密度住房附近的居民如何受到这些住房的影响并作出反应。通过利用与40B开发项目邻近程度的超本地化差异，我们发现平均而言，这些开发项目并未影响周边居民的房产价值（95%置信区间：[–0.4%, 2.4%]）。对于确实导致价值下降的大型开发项目，居民的迁出和政治回应微乎其微甚至不存在。

title: Willingness to Pay for Workplace Amenities

title_secondary: Willingness to Pay for Workplace Amenities
authors: Anelli, Massimo, Koenig, Felix
official: 来源期次 American Economic Journal: Applied Economics · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: We develop a revealed preference approach to measure the value of workplace amenities by analyzing how variation in non-wage job attributes affects excess mass in the earnings distribution at budget discontinuities. The approach formalizes the idea that workers respond less to monetary incentives when amenities constitute a larger share of total compensation. Applying this method to workplace safety during COVID-19 waves, we find that workers are willing to sacrifice 9% of their earnings to reduce weekly fatality risks by one in 100,000. The findings suggest that conventional hedonic regressions substantially underestimate the value of workplace safety.
abstract_zh: 我们提出一种揭示性偏好方法，通过分析非工资性工作属性变化如何影响预算断点处收入分布的超额聚集程度，来测算工作场所福利的价值。该方法将以下理念形式化：当福利在总薪酬中占比更大时，劳动者对货币激励的反应会减弱。将该方法应用于新冠疫情浪潮期间的工作场所安全研究，我们发现劳动者愿意牺牲9%的收入，以将每周十万分之一的死亡风险降低一个单位。研究结果表明，传统特征回归方法会显著低估工作场所安全的价值。

title: Early-life experiences of labour markets faced by others can leave permanent scars on men’s willingness to work

abstract: Labour force participation among prime-aged American men has fallen for over half a century, and standard explanations leave much of the decline unaccounted for. This column combines panel and survey data to show that the labour markets these men experienced while growing up shaped their willingness to work decades later. These effects survive childhood moves across states and likely operate through men’s beliefs about whether work will pay off. If temporary downturns in labour demand can persistently influence labour supply, anchoring expectations about employment, not just inflation, may have a place in macroeconomic policy.
abstract_zh: 美国壮年男性劳动力参与率已持续下降逾半个世纪，而标准解释未能完全说明这一下降的原因。本专栏结合面板数据与调查数据表明，这些男性在成长过程中经历的劳动力市场状况，会影响他们数十年后的工作意愿。即便在童年跨州迁移的情况下，这种影响依然存在，且很可能通过男性对工作是否值得付出的信念发挥作用。如果劳动力需求的暂时低迷能够持续影响劳动力供给，那么锚定就业预期（而不仅仅是通胀预期）或许应在宏观经济政策中占有一席之地。

title: Frontier Markets: Analyzing Drivers of Market Growth and Sovereign Risks

official: 官方在线 2026-07-03 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Frontier Market (FM) status serves as a steppingstone for Low-Income Countries (LICs) aspiring to become Emerging Markets (EMs). Since the concept first emerged over three decades ago, FMs have gained substantial investment appeal, particularly after the 2008 Global Financial Crisis. At the same time, the recent series of global shocks starting with the COVID-19 pandemic highlighted the countries’ persistent vulnerabilities. This paper seeks to deepen our understanding of FMs by offering new analysis on the determinants of frontier market status and, using a dynamic country sample, examining the factors that help LICs attain and lose FM status. It finds that building robust macroeconomic fundamentals and ensuring good governance are critical for becoming an FM. In addition, the paper identifies flexible exchange rates, substantial official reserve buffers, and relatively low public debt and deficit levels as key contributors to lessening the sensitivity of FMs’ sovereign spreads to changes in global financial conditions.
abstract_zh: 前沿市场（FM）地位是低收入国家（LICs）迈向新兴市场（EMs）的跳板。自三十多年前这一概念首次提出以来，FM已获得显著的投资吸引力，尤其是在2008年全球金融危机之后。与此同时，从新冠疫情开始的一系列近期全球冲击凸显了这些国家持续存在的脆弱性。本文旨在通过提供关于前沿市场地位决定因素的新分析，并利用动态国家样本，考察帮助低收入国家获得和失去FM地位的因素，从而加深我们对FM的理解。研究发现，构建稳健的宏观经济基本面并确保良好的治理是成为FM的关键。此外，本文指出，灵活的汇率制度、充足的外汇储备缓冲、以及相对较低的公共债务和赤字水平，是降低FM主权利差对全球金融状况变化敏感性的关键因素。

title: Improving robust decisions with data
title_zh: 利用数据改进稳健决策

title_secondary: Improving robust decisions with data
authors: Xiaoyu Cheng
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-09 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: A decision‐maker faces uncertainty governed by a data‐generating process (DGP), which is only known to belong to a set of sequences of independent but possibly non‐identical distributions. A robust decision maximizes the expected payoff against the worst possible DGP in this set. This paper characterizes when and how such robust decisions can be objectively improved with data; that is, can yield higher expected payoffs under the true DGP regardless of which DGP is the truth. It further develops simple and novel inference procedures that achieve such improvement, while common methods (e.g., maximum likelihood) may fail to do so.
abstract_zh: 决策者面临由数据生成过程（DGP）主导的不确定性，该过程仅已知属于一组独立但可能非同分布序列的集合。稳健决策旨在最大化该集合中最差可能DGP下的期望收益。本文刻画了此类稳健决策何时以及如何能够通过数据实现客观改进——即无论真实DGP为何，均能在真实DGP下获得更高期望收益。进一步地，本文提出了实现此类改进的简洁新颖推断方法，而常见方法（如极大似然估计）可能无法达成这一目标。

abstract: This paper uses datasets on Chinese public firms to examine the impact of clan culture on firm export activities in China. We find that a one standard deviation increase in our clan culture measure leads to a 10.27% increase in the firm export intensity on average. Mechanism analysis shows that the role of clan culture in promoting export activities is due to the rapid information sharing among clan members. Moreover, these effects are more pronounced in regions predominantly inhabited by Han Chinese and those with low levels of marketization.
abstract_zh: 本文利用中国上市公司数据集，考察宗族文化对企业出口活动的影响。研究发现，宗族文化强度每增加一个标准差，企业出口强度平均提升10.27%。机制分析表明，宗族文化促进出口活动的作用源于宗族成员间的快速信息共享。此外，这种效应在汉族人口占主导地位以及市场化程度较低的地区更为显著。

title: School milestones impact child mental health in Taiwan
title_zh: 台湾学龄里程碑对儿童心理健康的影响
title_primary: 台湾学龄里程碑对儿童心理健康的影响
title_secondary: School milestones impact child mental health in Taiwan
authors: Kuan-Ming Chen, Janet Currie, Hui Ding, Wei-Lun Lo
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-30 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We examine child mental health treatment surrounding three school milestones in Taiwan: Middle school entry, high stakes testing for high school entrance, and college entrance exams. Using age cutoffs for school entry, we compare August-born to September-born children since the August-born reach each milestone one year earlier. Comparing adjacent cohorts of children born in the same month yields similar estimates. We find that entry into middle school increases mental health prescribing of antidepressant, anti-anxiety, and antipsychotic medications. Use of psychiatric medications falls sharply following high-stakes tests. Effects are stronger in counties where parents and children have higher educational aspirations.
abstract_zh: 摘要 本文考察了台湾地区三个学校关键节点——初中入学、高中入学高利害考试及大学入学考试——对儿童心理健康治疗的影响。利用入学年龄截止日期，我们比较了8月出生与9月出生的儿童，因为8月出生的儿童比9月出生的儿童早一年经历每个关键节点。对同月出生的相邻队列儿童进行比较，得出了相似的估计结果。我们发现，初中入学增加了抗抑郁药、抗焦虑药和抗精神病药等心理健康药物的处方量。高利害考试后，精神科药物的使用量急剧下降。在父母和子女教育期望更高的县市，这种效应更为显著。

title: The politician, the press and the public: How politicians’ perceptions of the media shape UK aid allocations
title_zh: 政治家、媒体与公众：政客对媒体的认知如何影响英国援助分配
title_primary: 政治家、媒体与公众：政客对媒体的认知如何影响英国援助分配
title_secondary: The politician, the press and the public: How politicians’ perceptions of the media shape UK aid allocations
authors: Paul Clist, Martin Scott
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-30 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper examines politicians’ attitudes and beliefs about the press, their potential role in shaping aid policy and how these views differ from the public’s. We address these questions using survey data from 107 UK MPs and 2047 members of the UK public. We find a positive association between MPs’ beliefs that the news media influence public opinion, reflect public opinion, and are central to a political career—and a belief that the news media should influence aid policy. This suggests that politicians’ attitudes and beliefs about the media can play a role in shaping aid policy. We also find that MPs are significantly more likely to think that the media influences public attitudes towards aid spending than the public. This suggests that politicians could potentially be overweighing news coverage when making decisions about aid spending. Overall, these findings help fill an important gap in our understanding of what happens ‘upstream’ of aid allocations and add further nuance to our understanding of the media’s political effects.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了政治家对新闻媒体的态度与信念、这些态度在塑造援助政策中的潜在作用，以及它们与公众观点的差异。我们利用来自107位英国议员和2047位英国公众的调查数据来探讨这些问题。研究发现，议员们认为新闻媒体影响公众舆论、反映公众舆论，并且对政治生涯至关重要——这些信念与认为新闻媒体应影响援助政策的信念之间存在正相关关系。这表明，政治家对媒体的态度和信念可能在塑造援助政策中发挥作用。我们还发现，议员们比公众更倾向于认为媒体影响公众对援助支出的态度。这暗示政治家在做出援助支出决策时可能过度重视新闻报道。总体而言，这些发现填补了我们对援助分配“上游”过程理解的重要空白，并为我们理解媒体的政治效应增添了更多细微之处。

title: Financial impacts of standardized system specifications: evidence from japanese municipalities
title_zh: 标准化系统规范对财政的影响：来自日本地方政府的证据
title_primary: 标准化系统规范对财政的影响：来自日本地方政府的证据
title_secondary: Financial impacts of standardized system specifications: evidence from japanese municipalities
authors: Naruki Notsu, Shuko Harada, Yu Osaki
official: 官方在线 2026-06-27 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper examines whether standardized system specifications improve the fiscal efficiency of local governments. Although ICT has been widely promoted through e-government initiatives to improve government operations, the effectiveness of system standardization has received limited attention. We study Japan’s Regional Information Platform (RIP), a standardized system specification that facilitates interoperability across municipal administrative systems and weakens vendor lock-in. Building on a model of municipal procurement under switching costs, we show that standardization reduces expenditure through two channels: weakened vendor lock-in that lowers system costs, and improved cross-departmental interoperability that reduces labor input. Using variation in RIP adoption across Japanese municipalities, we estimate difference-in-differences models and find that RIP adoption substantially reduces per capita total expenditure. These findings suggest that e-government outcomes depend not only on ICT adoption itself but also on whether administrative systems are standardized and interoperable.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了标准化系统规范是否能够提升地方政府的财政效率。尽管信息通信技术（ICT）已通过电子政务倡议被广泛推广以改善政府运作，但系统标准化的有效性却鲜少受到关注。我们研究了日本的区域信息平台（RIP），这是一种标准化系统规范，旨在促进市政行政系统间的互操作性并削弱供应商锁定效应。基于一个考虑转换成本的市政采购模型，我们证明标准化通过两条渠道降低支出：一是削弱供应商锁定从而降低系统成本，二是改善跨部门互操作性从而减少劳动投入。利用日本各市町村RIP采纳情况的差异，我们估计了双重差分模型，发现RIP采纳显著降低了人均总支出。这些研究结果表明，电子政务的成效不仅取决于ICT采纳本身，还取决于行政系统是否标准化且具备互操作性。

abstract: This paper proposes corrected forecast combinations when the original combined forecast errors are serially dependent. Motivated by the classic Bates and Granger (1969) example, we show that combined forecast errors can be strongly autocorrelated and that a simple correction - adding a fraction of the previous combined error to the next-period combined forecast - can deliver sizable improvements in forecast accuracy, often exceeding the original gains from combining. We formalize the approach within the conditional-risk framework of Gibbs and Vasnev (2024), in which the combined error decomposes into a predictable component (measurable at the forecast origin) and an innovation. We then link this correction to efficient estimation of combination weights under time-series dependence via GLS, allowing joint estimation of weights and an error-covariance structure. Using the U.S. Survey of Professional Forecasters for major macroeconomic indices across various subsamples (including pre/post-2000, GFC, and COVID), we find that a parsimonious correction of the mean forecast with a coefficient around 0.5 is a robust starting point and often yields material improvements in forecast accuracy. For optimal-weight forecasts, the correction substantially mitigates the forecast combination puzzle by turning poorly performing out-of-sample optimal-weight combinations into competitive forecasts.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种修正的组合预测方法，适用于原始组合预测误差存在序列相关性的情形。受Bates和Granger（1969）经典案例的启发，我们证明组合预测误差可能呈现强自相关性，而一个简单的修正——将上一期组合误差的一部分加入下一期组合预测——能够显著提升预测精度，其改进幅度往往超过组合本身带来的原始收益。我们在Gibbs和Vasnev（2024）的条件风险框架内对该方法进行了形式化处理，在该框架中，组合误差可分解为可预测成分（在预测起点可测）和创新项。随后，我们将该修正与时间序列依赖条件下通过广义最小二乘法对组合权重的高效估计联系起来，从而实现对权重与误差协方差结构的联合估计。基于美国专业预测者调查中主要宏观经济指标在不同子样本（包括2000年前后、全球金融危机及新冠疫情期间）的数据，我们发现，对均值预测采用系数约为0.5的简约修正是一个稳健的起点，且通常能带来预测精度的实质性提升。对于最优权重预测而言，该修正通过将表现不佳的样本外最优权重组合转化为具有竞争力的预测，显著缓解了预测组合难题。

title: Dollar Erosion: Understanding the Loss of Reserve Currency Status
title_zh: 美元侵蚀：理解储备货币地位的丧失
title_primary: 美元侵蚀：理解储备货币地位的丧失
title_secondary: Dollar Erosion: Understanding the Loss of Reserve Currency Status
authors: Zhengyang Jiang, Arvind Krishnamurthy, Hanno Lustig, Robert J. Richmond
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We quantify the impact of the loss of reserve currency status in goods and asset markets. In goods markets, the loss of seigniorage (1% of GDP per annum) makes American households spend less, mostly on U.S. goods, leaving an excess supply of U.S. goods to be cleared by a real depreciation of the dollar. The larger the home bias and the lower the elasticity of substitution between home and foreign goods, the larger the required depreciation. Standard parameters imply an 8.8% real depreciation of the dollar. In asset markets, about 50% of GDP in dollar bonds must be reabsorbed by home investors, raising the U.S. real interest rate. Standard parameters imply a 90 basis points rise, leading to an aggregate wealth loss of roughly one year of U.S. GDP.
abstract_zh: 我们量化了失去商品和资产市场储备货币地位的影响。在商品市场中，铸币税收益的丧失（每年占GDP的1%）导致美国家庭减少支出，其中大部分支出削减针对美国商品，从而产生美国商品的超额供给，需通过美元实际贬值来出清。本国偏好越强、本国与外国商品之间的替代弹性越低，所需的贬值幅度就越大。标准参数设定下，美元需实际贬值8.8%。在资产市场中，约50% GDP规模的美元债券必须由国内投资者重新吸收，这将推高美国实际利率。标准参数设定下，利率将上升90个基点，导致总财富损失约为美国一年GDP的规模。

title: Silence speaks volumes: dynamic cheap talk over a static issue
title_zh: 沉默胜千言：静态议题下的动态廉价磋商
title_primary: 沉默胜千言：静态议题下的动态廉价磋商
title_secondary: Silence speaks volumes: dynamic cheap talk over a static issue
authors: Gunhaeng Lee
official: 官方在线 2026-06-12 · 来源：RSS
abstract: I extend the canonical cheap talk model to a continuous-time setting in which a biased sender privately observes the state and strategically chooses when to communicate, while a receiver decides when to stop waiting and act. Waiting is costly because both players discount future payoffs. In equilibrium, information is gradually revealed through strategic silence: the sender’s silence at certain times signals valuable information, allowing the receiver to update her beliefs continuously. This generates an unraveling process in which increasingly high types are revealed over time under positive bias, and increasingly low types are revealed under negative bias. Learning remains incomplete, however, because waiting costs eventually induce the receiver to stop and make an educated guess. I derive conditions for the existence of this dynamic revelation equilibrium and show that strategic timing can enhance information transmission and receiver welfare relative to static cheap talk. I also show that multiple senders with opposing biases accelerate learning and increase the extent of revelation.
abstract_zh: 我将经典的廉价交谈模型扩展到连续时间框架中，其中，有偏见的发送者私下观察状态，并策略性地选择沟通时机，而接收者则决定何时停止等待并采取行动。等待是有成本的，因为双方都会对未来收益进行折现。在均衡状态下，信息通过策略性沉默逐渐揭示：发送者在特定时刻的沉默传递了有价值的信息，使接收者能够持续更新其信念。这产生了一个逐步揭示的过程，在正向偏见下，随时间推移，越来越高的类型被揭示；在负向偏见下，则是越来越低的类型被揭示。然而，学习过程并不完全，因为等待成本最终会促使接收者停止等待并做出有根据的猜测。我推导了这种动态揭示均衡存在的条件，并表明，与静态廉价交谈相比，策略性时机选择能增强信息传递并提高接收者的福利。我还证明，多个持有对立偏见的发送者会加速学习过程并增加揭示的程度。

title: A Divisia Measure of the Money Supply for Mexico
title_zh: 墨西哥货币供给的Divisia测度
title_primary: 墨西哥货币供给的Divisia测度
title_secondary: A Divisia Measure of the Money Supply for Mexico
authors: LUIS FERNANDO COLUNGA‐RAMOS, VICTOR J. VALCARCEL
source: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
official: 官方在线 2026-05-26 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We produce the first measure of Divisia money for Mexico. Various structural VAR identifications with Divisia M4 as an indicator of monetary policy yield responses of production and prices that are in every case at least as sensible as—and generally offer an improvement over—their counterpart specifications with a short‐term offer rate as the indicator. Importantly, we find that our Divisia specifications do not require expanding the model's information set with commodity prices or the real exchange rate for a resolution of the price puzzle. We reach similar conclusions for Mexico to those Keating et al. (2019) arrive at for the U.S. economy.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了墨西哥首个Divisia货币度量指标。采用多种结构VAR识别方法，以Divisia M4作为货币政策指标，所得产出与价格响应在各类情形下至少与以短期利率为指标的对应设定同样合理，且通常表现更优。重要的是，我们发现Divisia设定无需在模型信息集中加入大宗商品价格或实际汇率即可解决价格之谜。我们得出的关于墨西哥的结论，与Keating等人（2019）针对美国经济的研究发现相呼应。

title: Quote Competition in Corporate Bonds
title_zh: 公司债券中的报价竞争
title_primary: 公司债券中的报价竞争
title_secondary: Quote Competition in Corporate Bonds
authors: TERRENCE HENDERSHOTT, DAN LI, DMITRY LIVDAN, NORMAN SCHÜRHOFF, KUMAR VENKATARAMAN
official: 官方在线 2026-05-22 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Dealer quotes in corporate bonds, though indicative, lower trading costs and increase trading volume. Dealers offering higher quality quotes attract more order flow and execute trades at favorable prices. Dealers advertise quotes to manage their inventories and attract orders from nonrelationship clients. However, quote competition is imperfect. The best quotes often fail to attract orders, and trade‐throughs are common. Nevertheless, quote competition is important as clients exploit quotes from other dealers in negotiations, forcing dealers with lower quality quotes to offer price improvements. Quoting is not a zero‐sum game, as more active bond‐level quoting leads to more bond‐level trading.
abstract_zh: 公司债券中的交易商报价虽为指示性报价，却能降低交易成本并提升交易量。提供更优质报价的交易商能吸引更多订单流，并以有利价格执行交易。交易商通过报价来管理库存并吸引非关系型客户的订单。然而，报价竞争并不完美。最优报价往往未能吸引订单，且"穿透交易"现象普遍存在。尽管如此，报价竞争仍至关重要——客户会在谈判中利用其他交易商的报价，迫使报价质量较低的交易商提供价格改善。报价并非零和博弈，因为更活跃的债券层面报价会带来更多债券层面交易。

title: Short-Term Financial Stress and Decision-Making: Evidence from Market Vendors in Addis Ababa
title_zh: 短期财务压力与决策：来自亚的斯亚贝巴市场摊贩的证据
title_primary: 短期财务压力与决策：来自亚的斯亚贝巴市场摊贩的证据
title_secondary: Short-Term Financial Stress and Decision-Making: Evidence from Market Vendors in Addis Ababa
authors: Sylvia Blom
official: 官方在线 2026-02-09 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Financial stress is correlated with behavioral biases thought to negatively affect quality of economic decision-making. To investigate whether this hypothesis holds for short-term (acute) financial stress, I conducted a lab-in-the-field experiment with vendors in neighborhood markets in Addis Ababa. Half of the vendors in the study were visited by a mystery shopper who made a single sizable purchase at their stalls, tripling vendors’ average daily earnings on that day but leaving their poverty status unchanged. Vendors who received this unanticipated earnings shock reported higher than expected earnings and an improvement in psychological well-being. However, the unanticipated increase in earnings did not translate into improved cognition or decision-making. Descriptive evidence shows that monthly shortfalls in earnings are more predictive of better-quality decision-making (as proxied by income-seeking behavior) than day-to-day variation in earnings.
abstract_zh: 财务压力与被认为会对经济决策质量产生负面影响的行为偏差相关联。为探究这一假设是否适用于短期（急性）财务压力情境，我在亚的斯亚贝巴社区市场对摊贩开展了一项实地实验。研究中，半数摊贩遭遇了一位神秘顾客，在其摊位进行了一次大额购买，使这些摊贩当日平均收入增至三倍，但并未改变其贫困状态。收到这一意外收入冲击的摊贩报告称，其收入高于预期，且心理健康状况有所改善。然而，这一意外收入增加并未转化为认知能力或决策质量的提升。描述性证据表明，月度收入短缺比日常收入波动更能预测更高质量的决策（以寻求收入行为作为代理指标）。

title: Are Simultaneously Decided Referenda Substitutable? Evidence from Municipal Land Use Ballot Measures
title_zh: 同时决定的公投是否可替代？来自市政土地利用投票措施的证据
title_primary: 同时决定的公投是否可替代？来自市政土地利用投票措施的证据
title_secondary: Are Simultaneously Decided Referenda Substitutable? Evidence from Municipal Land Use Ballot Measures
authors: Gammans, M., Sanchirico, J. N., Kroetz, K., Armsworth, P. R., Swiedler, E. W.
official: 官方在线 2021-09-27 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The results of ballot referenda have often been used to infer the preferences of voters for various types of policy. However, voters may be influenced by the appearance of competing ballot referenda. We propose a simple theoretical framework for considering the substitutability or complementarity of various land use policies and apply this framework to a novel dataset of 603 land-related municipal ballot measures in California. We find that the appearance of a competing anti-growth measure decreases support for other anti-growth measures, while the appearance of pro-growth measures do not affect the likelihood of passage for anti-growth or pro-growth measures. JEL R52D72
abstract_zh: 投票公投的结果常被用来推断选民对不同类型政策的偏好。然而，选民可能受到竞争性投票公投出现的影响。我们提出了一个简单的理论框架，用以考虑各种土地使用政策的可替代性或互补性，并将此框架应用于加利福尼亚州603项与土地相关的市政投票措施的新数据集。我们发现，竞争性反增长措施的出现会降低对其他反增长措施的支持，而增长促进措施的出现则不影响反增长或增长促进措施通过的可能性。JEL R52D72
